instruction: Change the page orientation of this spreadsheet to landscape, resize cells to fit on a single page, and export it as a PDF with the same name under the home directory.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully resized cells in the spreadsheet to fit on one page and exported to PDF. Used Format > Page Style to adjust scaling, then exported via File > Export as PDF.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc menus, adjust page style settings (orientation, scaling), select all cells, configure print settings, and export to PDF.
metadata.task_rationale: Adds landscape orientation requirement to the original page-fitting and PDF export task, testing additional page layout skills.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing page orientation to landscape, fitting content to one page, and exporting as PDF. Evaluator checks PDF has exactly 1 page and landscape orientation (width > height).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads PDF from expected path (/home/user/Resize_Cells_Fit_Page.pdf) and extracts page count and orientation (width > height) using PyPDF2.
Metric correctly handles 'rule' type expected parameter by directly accessing expected.get('expected_pages') and expected.get('expected_landscape').

All three instruction requirements are verified: (1) landscape orientation via width > height check, (2) single page via page_count == 1, (3) PDF export with same name verified by reading from the correct path.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 each for page count and orientation) is reasonable for a two-requirement task.
Edge cases handled: file not found returns error dict, metric returns 0.0 for error results, zero-page PDF handled.
